bifrost: springboard/core/src/device_motion.rs, springboard/core/src/motion_manager.rs, springboard/sdk/src/sensors.rs, springboard/src/shell/rotate.rs (orientation consumer), springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs (Orientation enum)
summary: Core Motion reports accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, pedometer, altitude and activity data from device sensors. BifrOSt has a shared model for raw accelerometer and gyroscope updates and for device motion (attitude, gravity, rotation rate), exposed to apps through the SDK. The sensor feed that drives screen orientation and the magnetometer, altitude, activity and pedometer readers are not wired yet.

features.feature: Device motion (attitude, rotation rate, gravity-free acceleration)
features.note: built on parity/team-j-core-motion; not yet verified on Midget. DeviceMotionManager starts and stops updates, sets the interval and delivers attitude, gravity, user acceleration and rotation rate, fed by the accelerometer and gyroscope readings through SensorSource. The attitude frame is arbitrary (no magnetometer). The shell does not read it yet.

features.apple: Derived from CMAccelerometerData or CMDeviceMotion by the app
features.note: The shell consumes Portrait, LandscapeLeft, LandscapeRight and PortraitUpsideDown with Rotation Lock. orientation_from_gravity (springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs) classifies a gravity reading, but no in-repo code feeds set_orientation from a sensor (set_orientation has callers only in rotate.rs tests and an example), so the sensor reader is missing.

Sprint 3: RawMotion startAccelerometerUpdates / accelerometerData over the IIO sensor tree with sampling-rate snapping, tested on a fixture sysfs tree; no hardware on the lab machine, not yet checked on Midget.
Sprint 3: RawMotion startGyroUpdates / gyroData over the IIO sensor tree with sampling-rate snapping, tested on a fixture sysfs tree; no hardware on the lab machine, not yet checked on Midget.

features.feature: Recorded sensor data and batched history
features.note: SensorLog keeps a bounded, time-ordered history, queries it by time range and hands it back in batches of a given size, tested headless in springboard/core/tests/parity_sdk-complete-15.rs. Gap: no sensor feeds the log, and there is no SDK recorder or history store on disk, so nothing is recorded across launches.

Wave 2 (theme-27, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No step or pedometer data. Desktop PCs are not carried by users, so this is low priority. round 75, host only: SDK path; no sensor feed.
Apple Watch only, with a dedicated data-collection requirement.
Apple Watch and iPhone only, tied to emergency services.

gaps: No app-facing API for device motion on the shell side: DeviceMotionManager is in springboard/core/src/device_motion.rs and the SDK re-exports it, but no app or shell caller uses it yet.
The orientation feed is missing from this repo: springboard/src/shell/rotate.rs documents set_orientation as fed by the accelerometer every 200 ms, but no non-test caller exists here.
No magnetometer, barometer or altitude readers.
No motion-activity recognition, pedometer or sensor recording or history.
